preprocessing.pooling: 2x2 maximum ink; isotropic factor2, no interpolation
preprocessing.normalization: one global mean/std from training pixels only
preprocessing.calibration: per-lead calibration pulses retained in pixels; no numeric metadata feature
preprocessing.limitation: downsampling thickens narrow strokes and merges fine detail; variable page gain retained; not lossless waveform reconstruction

loss: unweighted binary cross entropy with logits; five independent binary targets
selection_rule: Strict lexicographic maximum of validation (macro_roc_auc, macro_average_precision, -probability_binary_cross_entropy); earliest epoch on exact tie
threshold_policy: fixed sigmoid probability >=0.5; no threshold search
search_budget: one prespecified small CNN+temporal-convolution configuration,seed42,max20epochs,patience4; synthetic-only resource checks; no architecture search on ECG outcomes
test_policy: one final model inference after freezing and train-only replay; fold10 has already been observed for CNNLSTM, so comparative results are exploratory; no test tuning
sequence_interpretation: 70 left-to-right image-feature positions over aligned lead rows; includes calibration/margin region; not recovered500Hz waveform samples
comparison_limit: Exploratory same-cohort comparison to saved CNNLSTM; same inputs/folds/threshold/optimizer/budget, one configuration/seed each. Architecture/head capacity and dropout topology differ; no external or seed robustness established. No Mendeley accuracy ranking.

uncertainty.method: patient-cluster percentile bootstrap of final test predictions
uncertainty.scope: test-sampling uncertainty conditional on this fitted model; excludes seed/training/external-domain variation

architecture.spatial_encoder: same depthwise/pointwise 2D CNN as PTBXL CNNLSTM, independently trained from scratch
architecture.temporal_head: 96-to-32 projection; two residual blocks with two causal kernel3 convolutions at dilations1 and2; per-position channel LayerNorm/ReLU/dropout
architecture.causality_limit: Head blocks left-pad; upstream2D CNN, GroupNorm and finalpooling use whole-image context. Offline classifier only.

paired_comparison.differences: new minus CNNLSTM on identical saved test records
paired_comparison.cluster: patient, same draw for both models
paired_comparison.limitation: conditional exploratory sampling intervals, exclude training seed/model-selection/external-domain uncertainty
